debt_events.summary: Exchange offer/consent solicitation: $1,114,603,000 (96.92%) of the 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 tendered and exchanged into $196.2M of new 7.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 plus 316,150,176 shares (total new notes $208.7M incl. $12.5M SteerCo premium); covenants and certain events of default stripped from the remaining 2027 Notes indenture.

Company determined the Exchange Offer qualified as a 'troubled debt restructuring' (ASC 470-60); FY2025 net income of $219.0M included a $548.7M non-cash gain on debt restructuring; ~$17.6M of debt issuance costs expensed. Reuters: the swap was launched to help avoid near-term default and 'hugely diluted' the stock.
New financing: drew $100.0M in aggregate under the Delayed Draw Term Loan Facility with Unprocessed Foods, LLC (Ahimsa DDTL); alongside ~$148.7M net proceeds from ATM common stock sales.

Q2 2026: conversions of a portion of the 2030 Notes produced a $57.7M non-cash gain on debt extinguishment; total carrying debt reduced to $323.8M and cash to $186.1M at 2026-06-27. H1 2026 gain on debt extinguishment $63.8M.

8-K announcing effectiveness of a 1-for-30 reverse stock split and authorized-share reduction, intended to regain compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement; conversion rates of the 2027 and 2030 convertible notes and warrants proportionately adjusted.

8-K: entered exchange agreements to repurchase/retire ~$15.0M principal of the remaining 0% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 at 96% of face value, settled in common stock (1,097,444 shares initially, up to 848,265 more at final settlement) — a discounted, equity-settled retirement of the last 2027 maturity.

credit_ratings.summary: No public credit rating: no S&P Global Ratings, Moody's or Fitch issuer or issue-level rating, outlook, CreditWatch placement or rating action on Beyond Meat, Inc. or its convertible notes (0% converts due 2027; 7% second lien PIK toggle converts due 2030) was found in any source reviewed through 2026-10-21 — including the cbonds issuer credit-ratings page for LEI 549300XQ946NCE51DR09, Moody's ratings-news search, and Beyond Meat's own SEC earnings releases, which disclose no rating on the notes. The notes appear unrated; no rating change in the last 12 months can therefore be reported.

output.risk_rationale: Beyond Meat is a distressed credit: FY2025 revenue fell 15.6% to $275.5M with a $179.3M Adjusted EBITDA loss, and it avoided a near-term default only via an October 2025 convertible-debt exchange the company itself accounts for as a troubled debt restructuring (debt cut from ~$1.15B of 2027 notes to $323.8M carrying value at June 27, 2026, against $186.1M cash), supplemented by a $100M term loan from Unprocessed Foods and ATM equity it can no longer access after losing Form S-3 eligibility. Continuing distress markers — days-beyond-terms doubling to 19 days, repeated material weaknesses and a terminated controller, a 1-for-30 reverse split to hold Nasdaq listing, recurring layoffs and customer losses — support a high risk call despite slowing cash burn (H1-2026 operating outflow $23.2M) and no going-concern qualification to date.

distress_signals.summary: Laid off 6% of workforce (~44 employees) and suspended operations in China (eliminating ~20 jobs, ~95% of local workforce) to cut costs amid slowing plant-based demand.

Announced another round of layoffs (44 employees, ~6% of global workforce, ~$0.8-1.3M severance charge, ~$7M annualized savings) with Q2 2025 results, and appointed AlixPartners MD John Boken as interim Chief Transformation Officer; targeted EBITDA-positivity in H2 2026.

Disclosed a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting (inadequate technical resources for complex transactions: compensation, debt, lease, warrant accounting); Q3 2025 earnings delayed ~1 week; Q3 2025 included $77.4M non-cash impairment charges.
Terminated corporate controller and principal accounting officer Yi (Jevy) Luo; CFO Lubi Kutua assumed principal accounting officer duties while a successor is sought.

Company discloses it no longer satisfies Form S-3 eligibility and is therefore 'unable to access our ATM Program', closing off its recent equity-raise channel; further material weaknesses disclosed with the delayed FY2025 10-K (filed 2026-04-09).
Effectuated a 1-for-30 reverse stock split and authorized share reduction to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement after the stock's collapse.

Reuters: annual sales declining since 2022 and never an annual profit; 'the company's survival hangs in the balance'; it has never flagged a going-concern risk but launched the debt-for-equity swap to avoid near-term default; hired a chief transformation officer and announced layoffs in August.
Customer-loss signal: reports that McDonald's removed the McPlant from its Austrian menu and is running out its Beyond Meat contract, alongside a ~27% drop in Q2 2025 US retail revenue.

payment_behaviour.summary: Creditsafe data shared with Food Dive: Beyond Meat's days-beyond-terms (overdue supplier payments) more than doubled in twelve months, from 8 days in Aug 2024 to 19 days in Jul 2025, vs a 12-day industry average; Creditsafe said the delays 'indicate that the company could be experiencing liquidity pressures'. The company said it was 'not planning to file for bankruptcy'.
